'''Kurlo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was the son of the [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]-based [[Crime lord/Legends|mob boss]] [[Reni Wajetta]]. Kurlo enrolled in the [[Dammon University]] on Corulag and Wajetta was willing to hire individuals to covertly intervene to ensure that Kurlo passed an exam that he required to graduate from the institution.<ref name="CatCW" />
